title: Dario Cannizzaro
_comment_promise: THE PROMISE LINE. This is the one thing the whole site hangs on. Swap `promise` and `promiseSupport` here and every page updates.
promiseSupport: This is where my writing lives: road trips with death, priests who fight zombies, detectives who travel back in time to solve a modern murder, roadside diners that vanish unwilling strangers to change the timeline. Welcome to my world.
metaDescription: Dario Cannizzaro is an Italian-Irish writer, screenwriter and director. Head of Story at True Story Studios. Author of the novel Dead Men Naked.
_comment_location: Two forms, deliberately. `location` is the full sentence form and is used only where it sits inside prose (the contact page). `locationShort` is the metadata form — the homepage eyebrow and the colophon — where the full one overflows its column and wraps. Keep the `//` in both: it is the site's mark for the two bases.
_comment_portrait: Drop a file into src/assets/img/ and name it here (e.g. "dario.jpg") and the About page grows a portrait. Leave it empty and the page renders as if the slot never existed — no broken image, no placeholder box.
_comment_credentials: The proof band on the homepage. Four items, no more — the fifth one dilutes the other four. `lead` is the part that renders bright; `tail` the part that renders dim. BILLING RULE: Head of Story, never co-founder.
